description: No security procedures and controls for working in secure areas to prevent unauthorized access and protect information.
applicability: This signal applies to: Data centers and server rooms Secure offices and work areas Information processing facilities Areas with sensitive information access Restricted zones requiring special authorization

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Review documented procedures for working in secure areas including sign-in/sign-out requirements, escort procedures for visitors, prohibition of unauthorized photography or recording, restrictions on food and drink, and requirements for unattended areas. Verify that procedures address both physical security and information protection while personnel are working in secure areas.
